sys_script_include.description: Single source of truth for scoped system property names, their typed accessors, and all custom choice VALUES. Callers use x_gegis_ins_policy.Constants.PROP.* for property names, CHOICE.* for lower_snake_case choice values (never raw string literals), and the helpers (getBool/getString/isAutoApprove/values) instead of hard-coding strings. GOLDEN RULE: every custom choice value is a lowercase constant defined here.
sys_script_include.name: Constants
